jobs.title: Head of Toronto AI Center
jobs.description:
Lab Summary

Samsung Research America (SRA) develops next-generation technologies in software, user experience, and services for future products. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with locations across North America, we partner with industry and academia to translate research and innovation into tangible outcomes. We lead in machine intelligence by building AI that is user-centric and physically grounded—AI that understands not just what users want, but their physical context and environment.

Samsung is uniquely positioned to bring this vision to life through nearly 500 million connected devices we sell annually. Our mission is to holistically integrate AI into connected ecosystems—homes, offices, robotics, and beyond—creating a platform that scales quickly while providing deep contextual understanding and spatial awareness.

The AI Center in Toronto, Canada plays a pivotal role in developing next-generation software, user experiences, and intelligent services that enrich consumers’ lives. This lab actively contributes to the international research community through publications and presentations at major conferences.

Areas Of Research

Computer Vision
Contextual/Multi-Modal Modeling
3D Perception & Scene Understanding
Inference and Reasoning
Machine and Deep Learning
Human Computer Interaction (HCI)
Natural Language Processing

Position Summary

Samsung’s AI research team in Toronto is looking for an outstanding and highly self-motivated leader to head the lab. The candidates should have extensive expertise in deep learning, computer vision and physics-based AI.

The AI research center is a key part of Samsung’s global R&D effort and aims to have direct impact on future Samsung products reaching hundreds of millions of users globally. The candidate will work with a team of research scientists and engineers tackling real-world problems involving Samsung’s Artificial intelligence products. The candidate can also have the opportunity to publish at top-tier conferences in deep learning, computer vision, and language understanding.

Position Responsibilities

Build, manage, develop, lead, and support the AI research team, with the outcome of high-impact research insights that influence the product roadmap
Present research findings and insights both within and outside of the company
Serve as a thought partner with the executive, cross-functional, and line of business leadership teams
Be an evangelist of research practices throughout the company, influencing partner teams
Drive innovation programs within the relevant fields of Artificial Intelligence,
Serve as the external face for the AI Research Lab’s advanced technology capabilities
Drive key University technology collaboration program to build long term innovation partnerships
Lead Technology Pathfinding to understand key technology trends and impact for Samsung, to help drive growth and new business opportunities for Samsung

Required Skills

PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
10+ years of post-PhD experience leading advanced AI research.
Deep expertise in vision and multimodal AI and agentic AI (autonomous agents, reasoning, decision-making), plus strong foundations in computer vision, image/video processing, and generative AI applications.
Significant experience of publishing relevant peer-reviewed articles on artificial intelligence
Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills, and the ability to program in C/C++, Python, Java, etc.
Experience in publishing scientific papers in top quality conferences/journals (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, ACL, SIGGRAPH, CoRL, etc.)
Experience in DL library such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, etc. with strong hands on experience is required
Experience working with GPU, parallel programming, and Simulation environments is a plus
Experience in Android development and graphic rendering is a plus
Ability to work as a team, motivation for international collaboration, strong communication skills, self-motivated, proactive, flexible and passionate about learning
Ability to work well in a fast-paced global team environment
Strong network of relationships with entrepreneurs, VC’s industry executives, and technology thought leaders
Strong presentation skills and excellent interpersonal skills

Additional Information

Disclosure of Trade Secrets

Samsung has a strict policy on trade secrets. In applying to Samsung and progressing through the recruitment process, you must not disclose any trade secrets of a current or previous employer.

Essential Job Functions

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, and frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Samsung Research America is committed to complying with all Federal, State and local laws related to the employment of qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact the recruiter or email sratalent@samsung.com.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Samsung, we believe that innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We aim to create a global team where everyone belongs and has equal opportunities, inspiring our talent to be their true selves. Together, we are building a better tomorrow for our customers, partners, and communities.

Samsung Research America is committed to employing a diverse workforce, and provide Equal Employment Opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For more information regarding protection from discrimination under Federal law for applicants and employees, please refer to this link: Pay Transparency

jobs.title: VP, Operations & Transformation
jobs.description:
About Big Viking Games

Founded in 2011, Big Viking Games is an independent Toronto-based consumer entertainment company behind YoWorld and Fish World, two long-running social games played by tens of millions of people over the years. Our business is built on loyal communities, recurring player engagement and a team with deep roots in web and live-service technology.

Today, we are modernizing how the company operates to keep pace with a fast-moving technology landscape. We are rethinking how our teams plan, execute and grow the business, and building an organization designed for the next decade of consumer digital products.

About The Role

As VP, Operations & Transformation, you will lead the modernization of Big Viking Games and run the operations that power the business. You will report to the CEO, serve on the leadership team and work alongside our product, engineering and creative leaders to set direction and deliver results across functions. Your remit covers studio production, product operations, people operations, accounting and IT, and the systems that connect them.

Success in this seat calls for an AI-native operator who builds with AI firsthand and leads the shift to a modernized operating model across the business. You bring a systems view of the organization, a strong command of operating leverage and capital efficiency, and the judgment to balance near-term performance with long-term value creation, while leading change through clear communication and strong stakeholder alignment.

We value in-person collaboration, and this role works from our Toronto Harbourfront office 3 to 4 days a week.

What You'll Do

This is a hands-on executive role at the center of the business, connecting strategy, operations and people across every function:

Lead the transformation agenda. Define the roadmap for modernizing the company's operating model, and drive it from design through adoption across every function
Run operations across the business. Lead studio and product operations, people operations, accounting and IT, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes
Own the operating plan. Partner with the CEO on the P&L, set the annual operating plan and cost structure, and track performance against it
Modernize processes and systems. Bring in modern tools and practices, including AI, where they create the most value, and measure the impact they deliver
Build the team and culture. Shape the structure, roles and culture for the company's next chapter, and develop the leaders who will carry it forward
Drive strategic initiatives. Lead priorities that span teams, run the planning and review rhythm, and keep the leadership team aligned on what matters most

Requirements

What You Bring

15+ years of experience, including 3+ years leading a P&L or operating budget
Experience in consumer software or digital services businesses, ideally with transactional or subscription revenue
You use and build with AI daily, have led its adoption across teams, and set a high bar for how effectively your organization puts it to work
Strong executive communication. You bring clarity to complex decisions, write and present with precision, and keep leaders aligned on priorities and trade-offs
A collaborative leadership style. You build trust across creative, technical and business teams and bring people together around shared priorities

Nice to Haves

Experience in gaming or interactive entertainment
A background in management consulting, investment banking or private equity
Experience reporting to a board or working closely with investors and lenders
A track record of leading company-wide transformation or operating model redesign, from strategy through execution

Benefits

Comprehensive benefits package
, including health, dental, and vision coverage.

HSA/WSA spending account from day one
Participation in the Employee Stock Option Plan
RRSP participation and matching
15 vacation & wellness days
Access to leading AI tools

Hiring Process and AI Disclosure

This posting is for a new role.

Big Viking Games may use AI-assisted tools at some steps of the recruiting process, including application review support, candidate research, interview preparation, scheduling support, and workflow administration.

AI does not make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by people.

Accessibility and Accommodation

Big Viking Games is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. We welcome applications from individuals of all abilities and will provide accommodations throughout the hiring process as needed.

If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact hr@bigvikinggames.com so we can work with you to support your needs.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 262549

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director – Data Solution Delivery, Wealth Management, is accountable for developing, leading, and overseeing the activities of delivery teams responsible for working with cross-functional development teams and business stakeholders to define and implement business strategies, product roadmaps, service offerings, and new features. This is a demanding hands-on and strategic role that requires knowledge of the financial services sector and emerging trends in the Wealth and Asset Management industry.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Take ownership of end-to-end delivery of wealth data exchange engineering use cases and work closely with business and technology stakeholders.
Participate in Data Engineering, Data Architecture strategy, medallion data hub architecture, and roadmap definition and review process.
Demonstrate strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services and Databricks.
Provide thought leadership in selecting next-generation technologies and architecture components as per the latest trends and Scotiabank standards, frameworks, and best practices.
Promote a data-first mindset across the enterprise to enable Scotiabank to become a stronger data-driven organization.
Identify, monitor, and mitigate cross-project or cross-program dependencies while managing relationships, anticipating/mitigating risks, facilitating communications, and leading projects in an agile fashion.
Engage sponsoring executives and project team members, establishing trusted partnerships to ensure deliveries within scope, budget, and timelines while effectively communicating and discussing analytic insights with senior stakeholders.
Balance collaboration and consensus with the ability to assert project management discipline where required, while being a seasoned practitioner in leading project teams through fast and complex projects.
Work in an agile manner to onboard data, define ETL business processes, and create and manage a data dictionary and data lineage.
Lead a team of data engineers and full-stack developers.
Excel in relationship, stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills, effective at all levels up to senior executives.
Efficiently perform management tasks including incident response and escalations, vendor and contract management, infrastructure management, service resiliency, and service ownership.
Enjoy the challenges of working on different types of projects (from large complex to simple).
Collaborate with various business functions to ensure Wealth Technology meets business needs.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Minimum 10+ years in a data engineering-focused role.
Hands-on technical leadership with proven experience leading and mentoring engineering teams.
Expertise in implementing Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services such as DataProc, Dataflow, CloudSQL, BigQuery, CloudSpanner in combination with third parties such as Spark, Apache Beam/Composer, DBT, Cloud PubSub, Confluent Kafka, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, and GitHub.
Experience with data streaming and technologies such as Kafka, Spark-streaming, etc.
Effective programming/query skills and in-depth knowledge of common data manipulation, visualization, and analytical tools (e.g., Python, Java, PowerBI, etc.).
Analytical, insights-driven with the ability to help the organization leverage data-driven decisions.
Strong architecture knowledge with experience in providing technical solutions for cloud infrastructure.
Active Google Cloud Data Engineer certification or Google Professional Cloud Architect certification.

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
Community Engagement - We offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Titre du poste :
Chef du Centre d’Excellence PGI

À propos de & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal.

Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Pourquoi rejoindre l’équipe des Technologies Numériques de Pratt & Whitney Canada ?

Nous sommes en pleine transformation numérique, redéfinissant notre manière de travailler, optimisant nos opérations et transformant nos produits et services pour améliorer les expériences des employés et des clients.

En tant que membre de notre équipe de Technologie Numérique, vous contribuerez à façonner l’avenir en travaillant avec des outils avancés, en automatisant les processus et en innovant dans toutes les fonctions de l’entreprise.

Notre organisation mondiale est déterminée à cultiver une équipe autonome et compétente afin d’apporter des solutions avancées et des capacités numériques à la pointe de la technologie à nos clients.

Sommaire du poste :

Il s’agit d’un rôle de leadership stratégique à fort impact au sein de nos opérations mondiales complexes et orientées mission dans la fabrication et la maintenance après-vente. Le poste bénéficie d’une haute visibilité et implique des interactions à la fois stratégiques et opérationnelles avec les équipes Digital Technologies (DT) et Business Leadership, y compris les cadres supérieurs.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien?

Diriger le COE (centre d’excellence) du ERP (PGI – Progiciel de Gestion Intégré) mondial, en définissant la vision, le modèle de gouvernance et la structure organisationnelle alignés sur les principes directeurs clés de l’organisation des Technologies Numériques de Pratt & Whitney.
Conseiller les parties prenantes en tant que leader stratégique et technologique, mobiliser l’expertise et les benchmarks industriels, et influencer au sein d’une organisation matricielle complexe.
Stimuler l’innovation et l’amélioration continue, anticiper les tendances technologiques et catalyser le changement pour améliorer l’expérience utilisateur et l’efficacité opérationnelle.
Gérer budgets, capacité et planification financière en collaboration avec les finances sur une base mensuelle.
Communiquer avec l’équipe de direction (SLT) et les cadres pour aligner les priorités.
Gérer les escalades, agir comme point de contact principal pour les problèmes prioritaires et coordonner leur résolution.
Contribuer à la satisfaction des employés, suivre l’engagement et le moral, et collecter les retours via des enquêtes de satisfaction.
Collaborer étroitement avec tous les groupes DT, y compris RTX, pour assurer l’alignement transversal.
Communiquer clairement les problématiques complexes en termes non techniques, tout en guidant l’équipe dans la collecte des besoins, l’analyse des processus et le développement de solutions globales.
Gérer et livrer un portefeuille complexe d’initiatives d’exploitation et de transformation ERP, et maintenir des feuilles de route stratégiques pluriannuelles avec les parties prenantes.
Concevoir et exécuter une stratégie de transformation SAP S/4 HANA spécifique à P&W, alignée avec le programme RTX.
Superviser les opérations quotidiennes du COE : relations fournisseurs, gestion budgétaire et des ressources, suivi de performance et évaluation des risques, en appliquant les méthodologies projet cascade et agile.
Gouverner la gestion du changement ERP, la planification des versions, la gestion de la demande, de la capacité et de la priorisation.
Piloter l’harmonisation des processus globaux et assurer l’alignement avec les objectifs métier pour la planification, fabrication, chaîne d’approvisionnement, qualité, logistique et finance (OEM et Aftermarket).
Maîtriser les ERP et processus métier de bout en bout (Opportunity-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Plan-to-Sustain) dans un environnement réglementé.
Superviser et optimiser un paysage ERP complexe (SAP et non SAP), incluant PLM, MES, portails fournisseurs, QMS et applications sur mesure.
S’adapter rapidement aux priorités changeantes tout en gérant risque et impacts sur le portefeuille.
Diriger une équipe performante et développer une stratégie de talents : montée en compétences, attraction de nouveaux talents, adoption de SAP S/4 HANA, Analytics et IA générative.
Gérer une équipe mondiale de leaders SAP et experts fonctionnels, promouvoir l’amélioration continue et le partage de connaissances.
Coacher et encadrer les membres de l’équipe pour soutenir leur développement professionnel et renforcer leurs compétences.
Garantir la conformité aux réglementations IT et A&D, aux normes de sécurité (ITAR, DFARS), à la loi SOX et aux contrôles internes.
Soutenir les opérations d’infrastructure pour maintenir les solutions à grande échelle et garantir une couverture 24/7, y compris jours fériés et week-ends.

Ce poste a été désigné comme « sur site
», avec un travail régulier en personne dans nos locaux situés à Longueuil, QC. Il nécessitera également des déplacements vers différents sites selon les besoins pour participer à des sessions de travail et collaborer directement avec différents intervenants de l’entreprise. Les déplacements sont estimés à au moins 25 %. Le poste est basé dans notre site principal à Longueuil, QC.

Quest-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?

Qualifications requises :

Baccalauréat en ingénierie, informatique, technologies de l’information ou systèmes d’information avec 14+ années d’expérience dans les systèmes ERP ; OU diplôme supérieur dans les mêmes domaines avec 12+ années d’expérience dans les systèmes ERP.

Qualifications recherchées :

Solide capacité de management – expérience démontrée dans la conduite et la gestion de projets ERP DT complexes et à grande échelle.
Orientation résultats – focalisé sur l’atteinte des objectifs malgré les obstacles internes ou externes.
Aptitude business forte – capacité à apprendre rapidement, comprendre et interpréter les processus métier, agir en tant que partenaire de confiance et être reconnu comme contributeur de valeur.
Compétences interpersonnelles solides – capacité à collaborer efficacement avec différentes équipes pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
Maîtrise des processus de cycle de vie logiciel.
Autonomie et proactivité – capacité à prendre en charge des missions et à livrer des résultats de manière fiable.
Excellentes compétences en communication – aptitude à transmettre clairement des informations complexes, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral.

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Ce que nous offrons

Programme de régime de retraite et d’épargne avec cotisation de l’employeur
Programme d’assurance collective
Possibilités d’avancement (progression de carrière)
Programme de mérite ou programme de reconnaissance
Programme de santé et bien-être, y compris la télémédecine
Club récréatif et sportif
Garderies à proximité
Accessibilité en transport ou programme de transport en commun et stationnement gratuit

Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada

Le masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d’alléger le texte. Nous étudierons la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde.

Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, vous avez l’occasion de faire une différence tous les jours ; il suffit de lever les yeux. Êtes-vous prêt à vous dépasser ?

Le candidat retenu devra se soumettre à une vérification de ses antécédents judiciaires et obtenir toutes les autorisations nécessaires en lien avec la manipulation et le transfert de marchandises contrôlées. L’offre d’emploi est conditionnelle à la réussite de ces vérifications et à l’obtention des autorisations requises. Si ces conditions ne sont pas respectées, l’offre d’emploi sera retirée.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance

Our client is seeking an experienced Director of Finance to lead and transform its finance and accounting function across a complex North American organization.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a CPA who combines enterprise-level leadership with strong operational execution. The successful candidate will have a proven track record of leading large, geographically dispersed teams of 25+ employees, driving finance transformation, and strengthening financial controls, processes, and governance.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical accounting expertise, including IFRS, alongside the ability to lead through other leaders while remaining hands-on in identifying issues, improving processes, and implementing sustainable change.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Reporting

Lead the finance and accounting function across a complex, multi-entity North American organization.
Oversee financial reporting, consolidations, month-end close, statutory reporting, and external audits in accordance with IFRS.
Establish consistent accounting policies, reporting standards, and financial governance across the organization.
Partner with executive leadership to provide financial insight and support strategic decision-making.

Finance Transformation & Process Improvement

Lead enterprise-wide initiatives to standardize, streamline, and modernize finance processes, systems, and reporting.
Assess existing processes, organizational structures, and controls, identifying gaps and implementing practical, scalable improvements.
Strengthen internal controls, financial governance, and risk management practices across entities and business units.
Maintain a hands-on approach to problem-solving, working directly with teams to improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and accountability.
Drive continuous improvement, automation, and effective change management while maintaining business continuity.

Leadership & Business Partnership

Lead, develop, and mentor a large, geographically dispersed finance organization, including developing managers and strengthening leadership capability.
Establish clear accountability, performance expectations, and organizational structures that support business objectives.
Partner with operations, supply chain, IT, and other functional leaders to improve financial visibility, costing accuracy, inventory controls, and working capital.
Build a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating financial and operational performance into actionable business insights.

Qualifications & Experience

CPA designation required.
15+ years of progressive finance and accounting leadership experience, including senior leadership at the Corporate Controller, VP Finance, or equivalent level.
Demonstrated success leading large accounting and finance teams across multiple locations and geographies, with experience developing leaders and managing through others.
Strong technical accounting expertise, including extensive IFRS experience and multi-entity financial consolidation.
Proven experience leading finance transformation, process standardization, and internal control improvements across a complex organization.
Experience assessing organizational structures, developing talent, and leading teams through significant change.
Strong executive presence, commercial acumen, and the ability to influence stakeholders across finance and operations.

jobs.title: Director, Financial Reporting & Internal Controls
jobs.description:
At Mitel, you will have the opportunity to help businesses connect, collaborate and provide better experiences for our customers. You will deliver valuable contributions in creating business success within our global organization utilizing your unique attributes, skills and experience.

Please take a moment to look over this opportunity and if interested, feel free to send us your application. If this is not the right opportunity for you, you can also sign up for Job Alerts by creating an account. This will give you a profile that you can use for all future applications, and you will be notified whenever a new position that matches your criteria becomes available.

The Director, Financial Reporting & Internal Controls is responsible for the Company’s consolidated financial reporting, technical accounting, global statutory reporting and audit activities, and oversight of the internal control environment. This role will oversee a small team, providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, workload prioritization and performance support while ensuring high-quality execution of key reporting and control deliverables. The role partners closely with senior finance leadership, regional finance teams, cross-functional stakeholders and external auditors.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare the Company’s quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements and related disclosures in accordance with IFRS.
Support quarterly and annual reporting processes and review significant accounting entries and adjustments.
Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial reporting across the organization.
Lead the consolidated financial statement audit, acting as the primary relationship manager with external auditors, coordinating key deliverables, reviewing and participating in the negotiation of audit fees, and resolving audit and accounting matters.
Serve as a key technical accounting resource and lead the assessment and documentation of complex and non-routine transactions under IFRS, including revenue recognition, share-based compensation, leases, pensions, restructuring and provisions, impairments, business combinations, legal entity restructuring and other complex accounting matters.

Customer and prospect data within our CRM;
Core CRM processes that enable selling across GTM teams (e.g., opportunity workflows, territory assignment processes); and
Our internal GenAI and automation efforts driving efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity of our GTM teams

What You'll Do

Own CRM data quality and governance

Set the strategy, standards, and governance for leads, contacts, accounts, and account hierarchies. That includes parent/child structures, holding companies, franchises, PE portfolios, and multi-site customers.
Move data quality from cleanup to prevention. Put in intake controls, matching and dedupe rules, and enrichment precedence, and track them on a data quality scorecard with targets.
Show leadership what data gaps cost in revenue, and make GTM data ready for AI use cases.
Lead the team doing this work, including writing requirements for GTM Systems to implement.
Develop deduplication strategies and processes to manage a dual CRM environment across MaintainX and Autodesk

Drive core CRM-based processes and workflows

Own CRM territory management developing the processes and systems requirements to implement the territory design and strategy defined by GTM leadership and Rev Ops teams.
Own our rules of engagement: account ownership, crediting, and conflict resolution across segments, regions, and teams – including both MaintainX selling in isolation and coordination between MaintainX and Autodesk sellers
Own optimization of CRM processes and workflows for end user teams, including building an understanding of current processes, identifying points of improvement, working with GTM systems and Rev Ops teams to define business requirements
Collaborate with Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM systems teams to ensure field teams know how to use our systems and processes as they change, through release communications, training, and documentation.

Lead the GTM AI program for field teams

Run out GenAI and automation program for GTM field teams end to end: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across GTM and Engineering, operating cadences, solution evaluation, executive readouts, field enablement.
Lead discovery with Sales leaders to find the highest-value automation and agent opportunities. Align leadership and our GTM engineering team on one prioritized roadmap.
Own business requirements, build-vs-buy recommendations, and testing for centrally built solutions. Partner with Engineering to build and launch them.
Set the standards for how teams build their own solutions: knowledge base governance, a quality bar, and a path for scaling proven team-built tools across the org.
Own rollout with Enablement and measure adoption and ROI. The measure is workflows changed, not trainings delivered.

Lead integration efforts for MaintainX GTM into Autodesk

Own the GTM integration plan, governance and coordination across the workstreams, including: systems and data, account mapping and ownership, territories, sales process alignment, rules of engagement for joint selling, and enablement.
Coordinate stakeholders across both organizations. Run the cadence, track risks and dependencies, and escalate decisions.
Be accountable for integration outcomes, not just coordination.

About You

10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM strategy at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years leading people.
Deep expertise in core sales processes, territory design, and rules of engagement.
Strong command of the CRM data model: Salesforce objects, account hierarchies, matching, and enrichment. You define and specify; you don't need to configure.
Hands-on experience bringing AI into GTM workflows (LLMs, agents, workflow automation), with results you can measure. Fluent enough to work credibly with engineers.
A track record of leading large cross-functional programs through influence, including with VP and C-level leaders.
M&A or GTM integration experience is strongly preferred.
Clear writing and speaking. You can make complex tradeoffs understandable to sellers, engineers, and executives.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Director of Finance

Our client is seeking an experienced Director of Finance to lead and transform its finance and accounting function across a complex North American organization.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a CPA who combines enterprise-level leadership with strong operational execution. The successful candidate will have a proven track record of leading large, geographically dispersed teams of 25+ employees, driving finance transformation, and strengthening financial controls, processes, and governance.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical accounting expertise, including IFRS, alongside the ability to lead through other leaders while remaining hands-on in identifying issues, improving processes, and implementing sustainable change.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Reporting

Lead the finance and accounting function across a complex, multi-entity North American organization.
Oversee financial reporting, consolidations, month-end close, statutory reporting, and external audits in accordance with IFRS.
Establish consistent accounting policies, reporting standards, and financial governance across the organization.
Partner with executive leadership to provide financial insight and support strategic decision-making.

Finance Transformation & Process Improvement

Lead enterprise-wide initiatives to standardize, streamline, and modernize finance processes, systems, and reporting.
Assess existing processes, organizational structures, and controls, identifying gaps and implementing practical, scalable improvements.
Strengthen internal controls, financial governance, and risk management practices across entities and business units.
Maintain a hands-on approach to problem-solving, working directly with teams to improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and accountability.
Drive continuous improvement, automation, and effective change management while maintaining business continuity.

Lead, develop, and mentor a large, geographically dispersed finance organization, including developing managers and strengthening leadership capability.
Establish clear accountability, performance expectations, and organizational structures that support business objectives.
Partner with operations, supply chain, IT, and other functional leaders to improve financial visibility, costing accuracy, inventory controls, and working capital.
Build a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating financial and operational performance into actionable business insights.

CPA designation required.
15+ years of progressive finance and accounting leadership experience, including senior leadership at the Corporate Controller, VP Finance, or equivalent level.
Demonstrated success leading large accounting and finance teams across multiple locations and geographies, with experience developing leaders and managing through others.
Strong technical accounting expertise, including extensive IFRS experience and multi-entity financial consolidation.
